svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Inputs
svg.desc: The expanded vision block uses ordinary additive residuals. The language backbone starts only after image replacement and stream expansion. Engram follows token identity through a separate lookup path and gates memory against the current encoder residual.

g.aria-label: Format messages + image markers — roles · generation prefix · image records
g.title: Format messages + image markers — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Regex → ByteLevel → BPE — 129280 addressable token IDs
g.title: Regex → ByteLevel → BPE — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Expand image spans + position types — raw IDs and types: [B, S]
g.title: Expand image spans + position types — inspect equation and evidence
Lookup token embedding rows — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Map IDs into normalized identities — separate from ordinary embedding IDs
g.title: Map IDs into normalized identities — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Causal n-grams → hash buckets — 3 orders × 8 heads
g.title: Causal n-grams → hash buckets — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Retrieve rows → project keys / value — 6144 retrieved channels
g.title: Retrieve rows → project keys / value — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Content gate → residual addition — before layers 2 and 15
g.title: Content gate → residual addition — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Flatten RGB patches → biased linear projection — [H×W, 3, 14, 14] → [H×W, 1024]
g.title: Flatten RGB patches → biased linear projection — inspect equation and evidence
g.text: Flatten RGB patches → biased linear projection

g.aria-label: Q / K / V projections — 16 heads × 64 channels
g.title: Q / K / V projections — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: 2D rotary positions — height and width rotate Q / K
g.title: 2D rotary positions — inspect equation and evidence
g.text: height and width rotate Q / K

g.title: Bidirectional image attention → output projection — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Add attention residual — preserve every patch position
g.title: Add attention residual — inspect equation and evidence
RMSNorm → SwiGLU → down projection — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Add feed-forward residual → next block — repeat for 32 blocks
g.title: Add feed-forward residual → next block — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Final RMSNorm → spatial concatenation → projector — 3 × 3 neighborhood: 9216 → 5120 → 5120
g.title: Final RMSNorm → spatial concatenation → projector — inspect equation and evidence

g.aria-label: Replace image positions; keep ordinary text embeddings — [B, S, 5120]
g.title: Replace image positions; keep ordinary text embeddings — inspect equation and evidence
g.text: Replace image positions; keep ordinary text embeddings

g.aria-label: Expand streams → causal encoder → decoder — [B, S, 4, 5120] · encoder 1–20 · decoder 21–40
g.title: Expand streams → causal encoder → decoder — inspect equation and evidence

svg.text: MODEL / TEXT, VISION AND TOKEN MEMORY
From token identity and pixels to residual state.
Vision computes features. Embeddings select rows. Engram remembers token history.
